connectorUiConfig.title: Bindplane
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [Bindplane](https://bindplane.com) connector reports the health of records delivered into Microsoft Sentinel ASIM tables from a Bindplane pipeline. Bindplane normalizes and routes OpenTelemetry data; configure a Microsoft Sentinel destination in your Bindplane pipeline and the `asim_standardization` processor stamps every record with an `AdditionalFields.Attribution.bindplane_source` marker so the queries below scope to Bindplane-routed rows only. Requires the Bindplane OpenTelemetry collector with the `asim_standardization` processor v1.8.0 or later.
connectorUiConfig.additionalRequirementBanner: This data connector requires the Bindplane OpenTelemetry collector running the `asim_standardization` processor v1.8.0 or later. See [the Bindplane Microsoft Sentinel destination guide](https://docs.bindplane.com/integrations/destinations/microsoft-sentinel) for setup.

sampleQueries.query:
ASimAuthenticationEventLogs
            | where tostring(AdditionalFields.Attribution.bindplane_source) == "bindplane"
            | sort by TimeGenerated desc

sampleQueries.description: Bindplane-routed events by ASIM table, last 24 hours
sampleQueries.query:
union withsource=TableName
                ASimAuthenticationEventLogs,
                ASimNetworkSessionLogs,
                ASimDnsActivityLogs,
                ASimProcessEventLogs,
                ASimFileEventLogs,
                ASimAuditEventLogs,
                ASimWebSessionLogs,
                ASimDhcpEventLogs,
                ASimRegistryEventLogs,
                ASimUserManagementActivityLogs
            | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
            | where tostring(AdditionalFields.Attribution.bindplane_source) == "bindplane"
            | summarize Count = count() by TableName

sampleQueries.description: Bindplane-routed events by upstream EventVendor / EventProduct
sampleQueries.query:
union
                ASimAuthenticationEventLogs,
                ASimNetworkSessionLogs,
                ASimDnsActivityLogs,
                ASimProcessEventLogs,
                ASimFileEventLogs,
                ASimAuditEventLogs,
                ASimWebSessionLogs,
                ASimDhcpEventLogs,
                ASimRegistryEventLogs,
                ASimUserManagementActivityLogs
            | where tostring(AdditionalFields.Attribution.bindplane_source) == "bindplane"
            | summarize Count = count() by EventVendor, EventProduct

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

Bindplane is a telemetry pipeline platform that collects, normalizes, and routes OpenTelemetry data. The Bindplane Microsoft Sentinel destination delivers normalized security telemetry directly into native Microsoft Sentinel ASIM tables.

Data Connectors: 1, Workbooks: 1
